scope: Focused narrative source review for a computational comparison of Citrus sinensis (+)-limonene synthase and Lavandula angustifolia LaLINS (R)-linalool synthase, with a 2026 structure-feature classification paper as context.
inclusion_criteria: Primary characterization supporting the selected enzyme identity, product report or structural interpretation.
Foundational direct experimental examples needed to explain product specificity and its limits.
The user-supplied 2026 paper and its version-pinned dataset/code record.
exclusion_criteria: Studies outside the selected enzyme pair and limited conceptual background.
Reviews or unrelated pathways when primary evidence was available.
No exclusion based on agreement with the intended narrative.
